author: SinOfStrife
name: PKLens
short: Silently check PluralKit profiles & fronters with 1-click menus. Works server-wide and as a personal User App!
description: A lightweight, privacy-focused PluralKit inspector for Discord. View public system profiles and current fronters without chat spam—all lookups are private and ephemeral. Works server-wide for everyone when added to a server, or as an account-level User App to inspect systems anywhere across DMs, group chats, and external servers!
install_msg:
Thanks for installing PKLens! Load it with `[p]load pklens`, then use `/pkfronters`, `/pkprofile`, or right-click any user profile (`Apps` ➔ `Fronter` or `Profile`).

**User App Setup (for DMs, group chats, and external servers — requires Red 3.5.10+):**
1. In the **Discord Developer Portal** ➔ **Installation**, enable both **Guild Install** and **User Install**, set *Install Link* to **Discord Provided Link**, and under *Default Install Settings* give **Guild Install** `bot` + `applications.commands` and **User Install** `applications.commands` (this makes `/pklens`'s **Add PKLens** button work).
2. Run `[p]slash sync` **globally** (do NOT pass a server ID—User Apps only work on global syncs), then refresh Discord (`Ctrl+R` / `Cmd+R`).
3. Click **Add PKLens** in `/pklens` (or open your **Discord Provided Link**) and select **Add to My Apps**.
*(Note: External servers that disable **Use External Apps** will block user-installed commands in those channels.)*
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store data. Looking up a user sends their Discord user ID to the PluralKit API at api.pluralkit.me.
